summary: Frontend-only verification of the CORE FIX for the customer 'Download Statement (PDF)' bug. Overrode window.open (via page.add_init_script) to capture the HTML written into the isolated new tab, and stubbed window.print. Seeded the exact requested sale (customer 'Ledgertest', 2 kg @ ₹100, received ₹50 → pending ₹150) via the New Sale tab, opened the customer profile via More → Customers → Ledgertest, and tapped customer-export-pdf. The isolated popup document was successfully created and contained the GARLIC HUB A4 statement — NOT the surrounding app page. All required text markers and derived totals are present in the captured HTML.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/pdf.ts printHtmlWeb(): correctly uses window.open('','_blank') then document.write(withAutoPrint(html)) — isolated document, not the app DOM. Iframe fallback with id '__stmt_print_frame__' is a solid backup for pop-up blockers.
withAutoPrint injects a setTimeout(window.print, 350) after 'load' — gives inline SVG time to lay out; good.

app/customer/[id].tsx buildLedgerHtml() uses escapeHtml on all dynamic strings — safe. Note: the tagline 'Garlic Supplier & Packaging' appears as 'Garlic Supplier & Packaging' in the raw HTML source, which is correct HTML and renders as intended in the browser.
Running balance uses round2 to avoid float drift; sort key is deterministic (ymd + createdAt).
openingBalance hard-coded to 0 (full-history statement) — fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Runtime seed via UI: 1 customer 'Ledgertest' with 1 bill (2 kg @ ₹100 = ₹200), ₹50 received on bill, ₹150 pending. Stored in browser localStorage only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To verify the fix: install a page.add_init_script that (a) stubs window.print and (b) replaces window.open with a fake window whose document.open/write/close capture the written HTML into window.__capturedPopup. Then tap [data-testid=customer-export-pdf] and read window.__capturedPopup.html. If pop-up blocked (won't happen with the fake), fallback to reading document.getElementById('__stmt_print_frame__').contentDocument. Nav path: tab-sale → sale-customer/sale-quantity/sale-price/sale-received → sale-save → tab-more → more-customers → click customer name → customer-export-pdf.

verified_behaviours.isolated_popup_captured: window.open was invoked; document.write received 8618 chars of statement HTML (NOT the app page)

rca of the issue: Original bug: expo-print's web printAsync({html}) actually prints the surrounding app page on mobile Chrome. Fix in src/lib/pdf.ts routes web exports through a new window.open('','_blank') document.write() (isolated document) with an embedded auto-print <script>, and falls back to a hidden iframe (id '__stmt_print_frame__') if pop-ups are blocked. This isolates the print scope to the statement HTML built by buildLedgerHtml(). Verified end-to-end: the captured isolated document contains the full GARLIC HUB ledger with correct ₹200/₹50/₹150 Dr totals.
